javascript_native_test_version: Official openai 7.30.0 requires Node >=22; its mocked-native-client integration tests are declaration-skipped on Node20. Paired facade capture, negative admission and exact server money fixtures continue running on Node20. Bedrock native tests are not skipped.
verification: Official API pages fetched; root rendered OpenAI Standard All models and AWS Anthropic Global cross-region pricing in browser. Public read-only pages; no paid calls.
basis: Public standard marginal gross USD; not invoice cash. Credits, negotiated discounts, tax, commitment or account allowances not inferred.
native_parser_boundary: Capture validates objects returned by the official SDK, not unseen raw HTTP JSON. Python OpenAI/Pydantic normalizes a boolean audio counter false to integer 0 before native capture; a regression records this boundary explicitly. Raw helper inputs retain strict boolean rejection. No pre-parse transport hook is installed. Only text/no-audio requests are admitted.

openai.admitted: Direct global https://api.openai.com/v1 Chat Completions, actual default service tier, exact served model, valid final usage. Short input <=272000; >272000 whole-request long tariff. Cache read/write replace uncached input; reasoning replaces ordinary output, no double counting. Streaming requires final aggregate choices=[] and clean exhaustion.
openai.excluded: Other models/aliases, Azure, gateways, regional data-residency/FedRAMP uplift endpoints, Fast/Priority/Flex/Batch, tool/function calls, audio, incomplete/failed/cancelled streams, missing or inconsistent usage.

bedrock.routing: Global cross-region; source-region evidence is not destination-region data residency.
bedrock.admitted: Exact global profiles from default native bedrock-runtime us-east-1 endpoint, standard on-demand Converse and ConverseStream, text-only/no-cache, final usage+request ID+served default tier+standard latency.
bedrock.excluded: Bare model IDs, geo/application/provisioned profiles, other regions, Mantle, custom endpoints/resolvers, InvokeModel, prompt caching/checkpoints, guardrails, tools, multimodal input, additional model fields, missing/invalid/partial metadata, failed/cancelled streams.
